persona: Busy and apologetic that she is only lodging this now. Got a repair quote a few days after the accident and has not asked for a new one. Has one photo, the original invoice and the quote.
initial_message: Hello, I would like to make a claim for our dishwasher. On Monday 10 August I dropped a heavy cast-iron pot onto the open dishwasher door. The inside of the door cracked and the hinge bent, so the door no longer closes.

facts.incident.description: I was unloading the dishwasher and lost my grip on a heavy cast-iron casserole pot. It landed on the open dishwasher door.
facts.incident.cause: A heavy pot dropped onto the open door by accident
facts.loss.description: The inner door panel of the dishwasher is cracked and one door hinge is bent, so the door no longer closes
facts.policyholder.name: Chloe Karakaworth
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the dishwasher door, taken that evening. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: Tax invoice from Harakeke By Appliances dated 5 June 2023. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Repair quote from Harakeke By Appliances dated 13 August 2026, valid until 12 September 2026. I have not asked for a new one. Available now.
facts.if_asked_why_it_is_being_lodged_now: I kept meaning to do it but work got busy.
facts.if_asked_for_an_updated_quote: I can ask Harakeke By Appliances for an updated quote, but I do not have one yet. I can send it later.
facts.if_asked_whether_the_damaged_item_is_kep: Yes, the dishwasher is still in the kitchen. We are washing by hand.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo of a stainless-steel freestanding dishwasher in a kitchen with its door hanging open at a crooked angle. The grey plastic inner door panel has a long crack running from the middle to the lower edge, and one side hinge is visibly bent. A heavy black cast-iron pot sits on the tiled floor in front of it. The dishwasher has plain controls with no display and no markings. Evening kitchen light. No people, no text, no logos.

design.notes: Plan feature none with condition expired. The repair quote is dated 13 August 2026 and valid until 12 September 2026, before 1 October 2026. Open for the maintainer: main does not require a repair quote for contents (FAMILY_DOCUMENTS: incident_photo and proof_of_ownership), so evidence_outstanding here rests on reading "required material" as including a quote the claimant supplies. No template can print a validity date on a proof of ownership, which would make the condition unambiguous.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one dishwasher at the insured address, nobody hurt, photo and invoice supplied, policy on file. The repair quote expired on 12 September 2026 and no current quote is available yet, so someone must obtain an updated one. The largest known amount is the item value, NZD 1,349 (the quote total is NZD 731.40 including GST), under the threshold. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 5 June 2023 is before the incident on 10 August 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2019-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
